name: Fire out of turn returns 403
why: Player 2 cannot fire before player 1 has taken their turn — server must enforce turn order with 403

name: Valid fire returns 200 with result and game_status
why: Player 1 firing on a valid cell during their turn must return 200 with result and game_status fields

name: Duplicate join returns 400
why: A player already in a game cannot join again — server must return 400

name: Move history is empty at game start
why: GET /api/games/{id}/moves on a fresh game should return 200 and an empty array before any shots are fired

name: Place ships with valid coordinates returns 200
why: A joined player placing exactly 3 valid non-overlapping ships must receive 200 with status placed
